The company specializes in intelligent EV charging and has been an early driver of bidirectional charging, showing how EVs can support both households and the wider energy system. Through this partnership, Indra chargers can be connected into energy apps and flexibility programs powered by Enode. This allows Indra owners to connect their chargers to their energy provider’s app and access smart charging features without any additional setup.
